name: FEMA Public Assistance by project stage and age
plain: How much of FEMA's disaster Public Assistance in Puerto Rico is in projects that are closed out, open or waiting for a review, and how long the open money has been open, for the whole island, each disaster and each municipio. It shows where to ask, not whether a project failed.
definition: spending_fema_pa.json holds OpenFEMA's Public Assistance projects in Puerto Rico summed by process step (closed out, open, pending a review), with the federal share obligated in dollars, the dollar-weighted median years since each open project's first obligation, and the dollars open more than five years; island-wide, by disaster, by damage category and by municipio. Projects recorded as Statewide are summed apart.
unit: US dollars (not adjusted for inflation); years
geography: Municipio, with the projects recorded as Statewide apart

coverage.frequency: Monthly, when fema_pa_stage.py --refresh reads OpenFEMA again

method: fema_pa_stage.py reads every Puerto Rico row of OpenFEMA's Public Assistance Funded Projects Details: its process step, federal share obligated, first obligation date, disaster, damage category and county code. Closed is Project Closed Out; open is Obligated; pending is any Pending step. Age counts from the first obligation to the day the data were read.
how_to_read: Compare the share closed out and the age of what is open between municipios or disasters. A large share of old open money points to where to ask; large permanent works take years.
cautions: About three quarters of the dollars are recorded as Statewide and name no municipio: a municipio's figure is only the part that names it.
These are obligations, not payments: OpenFEMA does not publish what was paid on each project.
Closed out is FEMA's final reconciliation of costs; an open project can be finished on the ground and still waiting for its documents.
The same money is in the federal awards (assistance listing 97.036) and the FEMA series of the Analysis tab: never add them.
